info.name: Eva
info.summary: AI assistant for Nextcloud with cited file search and local or hosted models
info.description:
EVA adds AI-powered search and chat to your Nextcloud. Ask questions about your files and get answers with source links, so you can check where the information came from. Choose local Ollama models or configure a hosted provider.
## Why Eva AI?
EVA stores its search index in Nextcloud. Where AI inference happens depends on the model and integrations you configure. The default chat model, gemma4:cloud, uses Ollama Cloud; choose a local model in EVA Settings if chat prompts and retrieved file excerpts must stay on your infrastructure.
## Key Features
**Intelligent File Indexing** EVA reads and chunks supported files for semantic search, including plain text, PDF, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument, EPUB, saved mail, web archives, and Jupyter notebooks. Extraction covers readable document content; macros are not executed. Unsupported or unreadable files are skipped without stopping the indexing run.
**Hybrid Retrieval Engine** Combines vector-based semantic search with lexical search (BM25) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to deliver the most relevant results — even for exact-match queries.
**Cited Sources** Every answer includes the exact file path where the information was found, so you can always verify the source. Answers that used the web list the pages they actually retrieved, with their site and an excerpt, marked as web sources.
**Nextcloud Integration** EVA can work with Nextcloud Files, Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Tasks, Shares, and Talk. The available tools depend on enabled apps and execution surface; review action confirmations and settings before enabling write-capable features.
**Ollama and Groq Support** Use Ollama or configure an OpenAI-compatible hosted provider. Check each provider's settings to understand where prompts, retrieved excerpts, and tool results are processed.
**Talk Integration** Optionally add EVA to Nextcloud Talk. EVA registers one bot and can use its supported read-only tools in conversations.
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 30–35 - PHP 8.2+ - Ollama reachable from the Nextcloud server (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434) - Optional: hosted provider credentials, if you choose a cloud model
## Get Started
1. Install the app 2. Choose a local Ollama model or configure the default hosted chat model 3. Open EVA from the left sidebar and select your models in Settings 4. Start indexing and chat with your files
## Privacy
The default chat model is hosted by Ollama Cloud, so prompts and retrieved file excerpts are sent there for inference. To keep this chat data on your infrastructure, select a local chat model and local embedding model, and do not enable hosted providers or external connectors. Optional services such as web search, Mail, Talk, and OCR have their own data flows; configure them deliberately. EVA does not add third-party indexing or analytics.
